plan.title: AppSec: 2 HIGH + 1 MEDIUM — post-#3459 UAT Shell residuals (xcopy/robocopy/move/bun/deno/php/BitsTransfer/Expand-Archive plant authz + kill-switch; approved-scope mint)

narratives.Description: After #3459, residual dest-form writers still classify empty under active UAT and allow planting authz grants, kill-switch files, or approved-scope mint artifacts. This story closes those HIGH and MEDIUM residuals in classify.ts without overclassifying ordinary dests such as /tmp.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

AppSec scan on **`c83adf85`** (v0.105.0, post-**#3459**) found two **HIGH** UAT Shell classification residuals and one **MEDIUM** incomplete mint-path fix.

Under active UAT, further write-capable binaries still classify empty / unclassifiable and **allow** write-shaped Shell. That path can plant a forged `.deft/authz` grant or a regular-file `.deft-directive-disable` kill-switch. Separately, residual Shell writers can still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while Write is denied, so the #3410 / #3421 / #3459 mint gate is incomplete.

These residuals use dest forms that **#3459's harvest does not cover** (`xcopy` / `robocopy` / `move` / `ren` / `Rename-Item`, `Start-BitsTransfer -Destination`, `bitsadmin`, `Expand-Archive -DestinationPath`, `Tee-Object -FilePath`, `bun` / `deno` / `php` / `lua`, `--output-dir` / `-Destination` dest flags, `git bundle create`, `sponge`, `pscp`, `jj clone`).

**Repo / tip:** `deftai/directive` @ `c83adf85` (v0.105.0)
**Primary code:** `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts`
**Attacker model:** Agent under **active UAT** with PreToolUse Shell hooks

**Already denied after #3459 (do not re-report):** `ginstall` / `gcp` / `gh repo clone` / `iwr -OutFile` / `fsutil` / `cmd copy` / `tsx` / `ts-node` / `npm pack --pack-destination` / `install` / `cp` / `git clone` / `Set-Content` / `Copy-Item` / `Move-Item` / `Out-File` / `irm -OutFile`. Contrast: those peers remain settings-denied.

**Coincidental coverage (not a hole):** `docker cp` / `kubectl cp` / `gsutil cp` classify as settings because a later `cp` token is already an `INDIRECT_WRITE_BINS` member. Do not treat that as dest-flag harvest.

---

## Findings

### 1. HIGH — UAT residual after #3459: `xcopy` / `robocopy` / `move` / `bun` / `deno` / `php` / BitsTransfer / Expand-Archive still plant `.deft/authz` grants

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT with PreToolUse Shell hooks |
| **Input** | Residual writers whose dest is **not** covered by the #3459 harvest, e.g. Windows `xcopy` / `robocopy` / `move` (including `cmd /c` wrappers), `Start-BitsTransfer -Destination`, `bitsadmin`, `Expand-Archive -DestinationPath`, `Tee-Object -FilePath`, `Export-Csv -Path`, `bun` / `deno` / `php` / `lua` programmatic writes, unknown-bin dest flags (`--output-dir` / `--outdir` / `--target-directory` / `-Destination` / `-DestinationPath` / `--destdir`), `git bundle create`, `git checkout-index --prefix=`, `sponge`, `pscp`, `jj` / `sl` / `sapling clone`, Windows `expand` / `extrac32` / `makecab` / `replace` targeting `.deft/authz` dests |
| **Path** | Residual bins classify `[]` → `shell-op-unclassifiable` **allow** → forged **operator-cli** grant JSON → empty `activeGrantIds` activates human-origin grants → Write / push / PR / merge unlock (same class as fixed `copy` / `ginstall` / `tsx`) |
| **Impact** | Complete residual bypass of Wave 1 UAT human-approval after #3459 |
| **Fix** | Classify `xcopy` / `robocopy` / `move` as dest writers. Classify `Start-BitsTransfer` / `bitsadmin` / `Expand-Archive` / `Tee-Object` / `Export-Csv` dest flags (including PowerShell single-dash `-Destination` / `-DestinationPath` / `-FilePath`). Add `bun` / `deno` / `php` (and `file_put_contents`) to the programmatic write-bin set used for `tsx`. Harvest `--output-dir` / `--outdir` / `--target-directory` / `--destdir` when dest is `.deft/authz`. Cover `git bundle create`, `sponge`, `pscp`, `jj clone`. Under UAT, **fail-closed** on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell. Do **not** stop at named-peer allowlists. `cmd /c copy` / `ginstall` / `tsx` already deny. |

### 2. HIGH — UAT residual after #3459: same writer class still plants `.deft-directive-disable`

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Same residual class targeting `.deft-directive-disable` (or `.no-deft-directive`) as a regular file. Extra: `ren` / `rename` / `Rename-Item` onto a kill-switch basename (no `copy` equivalent). |
| **Path** | classify `[]` → Shell **allow** → plant kill-switch → subsequent tools `allow` / `directive-disabled` (#3039) |
| **Impact** | Immediate complete Directive gate bypass for the rest of the session |
| **Fix** | Classify those destinations targeting kill-switch basenames as **settings** under UAT. Include rename bins. Mirror the authz fail-closed posture from finding (1). |

### 3. MEDIUM — Incomplete #3459: residual Shell writers still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while Write is denied

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Residual dest writers targeting `.deft/approved-scope/**` after Write is denied for the same path (`copy` / `ginstall` / `tsx` closed; `xcopy` / `robocopy` / `Expand-Archive` / `bun` / `php` / `Start-BitsTransfer` still allow) |
| **Path** | Write denies the mint artifact; residual Shell classify misses the dest form → **allow** → forged provenance approval without `#3110` human-presence mint |
| **Impact** | Bypasses #3410 / #3421 / #3459 mint gate via Write / Shell asymmetry |
| **Fix** | Extend approved-scope classify to the same residual dest writers as findings (1) and (2). |

---

## Evidence

Live probe on **`c83adf85`** (`classifyShellAuthzOps` + `decideHook` Bash PreToolUse, active UAT, empty grants):

| Command | classify | decideHook |
|---------|----------|------------|
| `xcopy forged.json .deft/authz/grants/evil.json` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `robocopy src .deft/authz/grants` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `move forged.json .deft/authz/grants/evil.json` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `cmd /c xcopy …authz…` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `Start-BitsTransfer -Destination …authz…` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `Expand-Archive -DestinationPath …authz…` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `bun -e writeFileSync(…authz…)` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `deno eval writeTextFileSync(…authz…)` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `php -r file_put_contents(…authz…)` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `unknownwriter --output-dir .deft/authz/grants` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `unknownwriter -Destination …authz…` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `git bundle create …authz… HEAD` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `sponge …authz…` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `pscp host:g.json …authz…` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `jj clone … .deft/authz/grants` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `ren forged.json .deft-directive-disable` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `xcopy src .deft-directive-disable` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `bun -e writeFileSync('.deft-directive-disable')` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `xcopy … .deft/approved-scope/story.json` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `Expand-Archive -DestinationPath .deft/approved-scope` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `bun -e writeFileSync(…approved-scope…)` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `cmd /c copy …authz…` (#3459) | settings | **deny** / `authz-grant-missing` |
| `cp …authz…` (#3421) | settings | **deny** / `authz-grant-missing` |
| `ginstall …authz…` (#3459) | settings | **deny** / `authz-grant-missing` |
| `tsx -e writeFileSync(…authz…)` (#3459) | settings | **deny** / `authz-grant-missing` |

Ordinary dests such as `/tmp` stay unclassifiable (do not overclassify).

## Not re-reported

- `ginstall` / `gcp` / `gh repo clone` / `iwr -OutFile` / `fsutil` / `cmd copy` / `tsx` / `npm pack --pack-destination` — #3459 fixed
- `install` / `cp` / `git clone` / `Set-Content` / `echo` (approved-scope) — #3421 / #3459 fixed
- `Copy-Item` / `Move-Item` / `Out-File` / `irm -OutFile` — already settings
- `docker cp` / `kubectl cp` / `gsutil cp` — coincidental `cp` token, already settings
- `cmake` / `script` / editors `vim` / `nvim` / `nano` — #3382 fixed
- Generic `-o` / `--output` / `--outfile` / `--pack-destination` harvest — #3354 / #3459 fixed

## Acceptance criteria

**HIGH — UAT Shell residuals (must land together)**

- [ ] Under active UAT, listed residual binaries that write into `.deft/authz/**` classify as **settings deny** (not unclassifiable allow)
- [ ] Same bins targeting `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive` classify as **settings deny**
- [ ] Dest parsing covers `xcopy` / `robocopy` / `move` / `ren` / `rename` / `Rename-Item`, `Start-BitsTransfer -Destination`, `bitsadmin`, `Expand-Archive -DestinationPath`, `Tee-Object -FilePath`, `bun` / `deno` / `php` programmatic writes, `--output-dir` / `--outdir` / `--target-directory` / `-Destination` / `-DestinationPath` / `--destdir`, `git bundle create`, `sponge`, `pscp`, `jj clone` when dest is protected
- [ ] Prefer fail-closed on unclassifiable **write-shaped** Shell under UAT (not silent allow). Do not stop at named-peer allowlists.
- [ ] Regression tests cover residual bins vs already-denied peers (`cmd /c copy` / `ginstall` / `tsx` / `cp`)
- [ ] No false deny of ordinary non-authz / non-kill-switch dests (e.g. `/tmp`) outside UAT write paths

**MEDIUM — approved-scope mint symmetry**

- [ ] Under active UAT, residual Shell writers targeting `.deft/approved-scope/**` classify as **settings deny**, matching Write
- [ ] Forged Shell mint cannot satisfy provenance approval without the shared #3110 human-presence mint

**Release hygiene**

- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` security note (brief; no exploit cookbook)

## Related

- Residual of #3459 UAT Shell dest-form hardening (closed; this scan is post-fix on `c83adf85`)
- Residual of #3421 UAT Shell dest-form hardening
- #3410 mint (`scope:record-approved-scope` / shared #3110 gate); parent epic #3376
- Kill-switch contract: #3039
- Prior authz UAT Shell residual class: #3206, #3213, #3245, #3288, #3311, #3336, #3354, #3382, #3421, #3459

## Labels / routing

Security / agent-safety / tooling — framework-source fix in `packages/core/src/authz/`.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, I want residual UAT Shell dest writers classified as settings deny, so that forged authz grants and kill-switches cannot bypass Wave 1.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Extend dest-writer classification in packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts for xcopy, robocopy, move, rename bins, BitsTransfer, Expand-Archive, bun/deno/php, dest flags, git bundle, sponge, pscp, and jj clone.
2. Fail closed on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell under UAT for protected dests, add regression tests against already-denied peers, and write a brief CHANGELOG security note.
